description: This file contains unit tests for the QpackDecoder component of the QUIC protocol implementation, specifically testing header decoding, dynamic table management, error handling, and stream interactions in the quiche library.

classes.name: QpackDecoderTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the QpackDecoder, parameterized by FragmentMode, providing utilities for decoding header blocks and managing decoder state.

methods.name: QpackDecoderTest
methods.description: Constructor initializing the decoder with maximum dynamic table capacity and blocked streams, setting up stream sender delegate.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Sets up default behavior for error detection to reset the progressive decoder.

methods.name: DecodeEncoderStreamData
methods.description: Feeds data into the encoder stream receiver for decoding.

methods.name: CreateProgressiveDecoder
methods.description: Creates a new QpackProgressiveDecoder for a given stream ID.

methods.name: StartDecoding
methods.description: Initializes the progressive decoder for a new header block.

methods.name: DecodeData
methods.description: Feeds data fragments into the progressive decoder according to the fragment mode.

methods.name: EndDecoding
methods.description: Signals the end of header block decoding.

methods.name: DecodeHeaderBlock
methods.description: Decodes an entire header block from given data.
